description: Three-component multi-purpose coloured epoxy formulate for industrial floor coatings from 1 to 4 mm thick.
whereToUse: Coating floors in the chemical and pharmaceutical industries.
Coating floors in the foodstuffs industry.
Coating floors in laboratories, sterile rooms, and hospitals.
notFor: Do not apply Mapefloor I 300 SL ME on damp substrates or on substrates with capillary rising damp
Do not dilute Mapefloor I 300 SL ME with solvent or water.
Do not apply Mapefloor I 300 SL ME on dusty or crumbling substrates.
Do not apply Mapefloor I 300 SL ME on substrates with oil or grease stains or stains in general.
Do not apply Mapefloor I 300 SL ME on substrates that have not been treated with Primer SN or that have not been prepared as specified.

notes: 1) TWO DIFFERENT CONSUMPTION FIGURES for the product: the CONSUMPTION section gives 3.7 kg/m² at an average thickness of 2 mm, while the application procedure says the recommended total consumption 'must be at least 2.5-3.5 kg/m2' with no thickness attached. Both are recorded. The printed yield (47 kg kit gives 25.4 liters) and the printed mix density (1.85) agree arithmetically with 3.7 kg/m² at 2 mm, not with 2.5-3.5. 2) Thickness range is inconsistent: the description under the title says 'from 1 to 4 mm thick', the technical characteristics say 'layers from 2 to 4 mm thick'. No per-mm consumption figure is printed. 3) The sheet prints no mixing ratio row; the A:B:C proportions are only implied by the kit sizes in PACKAGING (17 kg / 5 kg / 25 kg), so mixing is null. 4) 'Density of mix' is printed as 1.85 under the unit (kg/m³); the unit label looks wrong for that number. 5) The Taber abrasion result 58 is printed under the unit (g). 6) The product identification table heads its three columns 'Component A, Component A, Component B' (liquid / liquid / powder). 7) Primer broadcast is described two ways: 'Application of the Primer' says fully broadcast with Quartz 0.5 (no rate given), 'Application of the product' says lightly broadcast at 0.7-1.0 kg/m²; the waiting times between coats differ for the two cases. The sheet also says the amount of sand added to Primer SN may vary with temperature. 8) Primer SN is quoted here at 0.3 kg/m²; the Primer SN sheet gives 0.3-0.70 kg/m² per coat. 9) The storage sentence is printed with a stray '+' ('must be+ stored') and the consumption line prints the name as 'Mapefloor I300 SL ME'; both copied as printed. 10) technicalData labels that begin with '-' are sub-rows as printed: '- on Primer SN with a light broadcast of quartz sand' sits under 'Waiting time between coats', and '- set to foot traffic' / '- full hardening time' sit under 'Hardening time'. The waiting-time rows carry the printed footnote '*surfaces must be dry with no dust'. 11) No EN classification is stated; only ASTM/BS test methods are cited, so standards is empty.
